title: Where to Purchase Jupiter (JUP): Full Guide

## Why Purchase Jupiter?

Jupiter (JUP) is a vital component of the [Solana](/solana) ecosystem, serving as a primary tool for liquidity aggregation. As the project integrates more advanced DeFi features, interest in the governance token has persisted. Market participants monitor JUP due to its strong narrative and its role in routing trades across platforms like [Raydium](/raydium).

## Market Availability Checks for JUP

Before depositing funds, verify current JUP market availability directly in the exchange or DEX interface. Listings, liquidity, regional access, and withdrawal networks change over time, so treat venue availability as something to confirm at the point of purchase.

Use this checklist before placing an order:
- Search for the exact JUP ticker and Jupiter name.
- Confirm the trading pair, contract address, and network.
- Compare spread, volume, withdrawal fees, and minimum order size.
- Send a small test withdrawal before moving a larger balance.

## Purchase Tutorial

To acquire JUP, you must first deposit fiat currency into a supported exchange, convert it into SOL, and then use that SOL to swap for JUP on the Jupiter platform or a connected DEX. Ensure you have a [Solana](/solana)-compatible wallet like Phantom to manage your assets outside of the exchange interface.

## Securing Your Tokens

While exchange storage is convenient, transferring your assets to a hardware wallet provides a higher level of security by keeping your private keys offline. Never share your seed phrase with anyone and use hardware devices for long-term holdings.

## Important Risks

With a TokenRadar Risk Score of 8, users must be aware that JUP is a high-risk asset. Market volatility is significant, and the asset has seen a yearly decline of -70.75%. Only allocate capital that you are prepared to lose, and stay updated on the latest protocol security audits.

## FAQ
- Is JUP available on all exchanges? No, JUP is primarily listed on platforms supporting the [Solana](/solana) network.
- Do I need SOL to buy JUP? Yes, since JUP is a [Solana](/solana)-native token, you will need SOL for transaction gas fees.
- Where can I find the official token address? Always use the link provided on the official website or verified block explorers.
